r0003225-106-108.summary: The training pairs: each glossed word of the letter of 17 July 1664 (image 106, and its second copy on 108) as cipher groups beside the gloss written over them at the time, e.g. "zeit von 3 wochen gestelt" and "sie 12 millionen".

r0003225-138.summary: Ebers reports that something has been taken into consideration and decided here: envoys are to go to Poland for the boundary commission, with the voivodes at Smolensk, to treat with the Poles; Marselis and Nashchokin are named, and someone is in favour ('in gnade').
